Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her backyard. One day, she saw a big, scary cloud in the sky. It made her scared and didn't want to go inside.

Later inside, Lily's mom made her a cozy bed under her bed. Lily snuggled up on her pillow and fell asleep. When she woke up, she was happy and safe with her safe home.
